assumptions.name: dc_capacity_mwp
assumptions.rationale: Aggregated commercial rooftop portfolio; not an announced Sembcorp asset.

assumptions.name: site_count
assumptions.rationale: Illustrative 60 equally sized sites; no actual rooftops identified.

assumptions.name: dc_ac_ratio
assumptions.rationale: Assumed 100 MWac aggregate. Licensing still needs site/unit AC capacity review.

assumptions.name: financial_close
assumptions.rationale: Future hypothetical close after the frozen information cutoff.

assumptions.name: construction_months
assumptions.rationale: January 2027 through June 2028; no pre-COD revenue in the baseline.

assumptions.name: base_COD
assumptions.rationale: All sites complete together; early commissioning revenue excluded.

assumptions.name: operating_life_years
assumptions.rationale: Operation through 30 June 2053; no terminal sale proceeds.

assumptions.name: PPA_years
assumptions.rationale: Runs from actual COD, subject to the fixed construction longstop.

assumptions.name: site_rights_end
assumptions.rationale: Fixed roof rights expiry; no automatic extension under delay.

assumptions.name: specific_yield
assumptions.rationale: Electrical yield after ordinary conversion/shading losses, before separately applied availability and curtailment. Not certified P50/P90.

assumptions.name: availability
assumptions.rationale: Applied once, separately from conversion losses; engineering assumption.

assumptions.name: curtailment
assumptions.rationale: Additional external lost production; no deemed-generation payment.

assumptions.name: annual_degradation
assumptions.rationale: Compound annual reduction after operating year one; not a manufacturer warranty.

assumptions.name: seasonality
assumptions.rationale: Allocate by calendar days; seasonal resource variation omitted and disclosed.

assumptions.name: contracted_generation_share
assumptions.rationale: Assumed as-generated contracted share; no firm-volume replacement obligation.

assumptions.name: PPA_price
assumptions.rationale: Hypothetical negotiated green-power tariff including attributes; no separate REC revenue and no actual Sembcorp tariff.

assumptions.name: PPA_escalation
assumptions.rationale: Fixed nominal tariff for 20 years, not wholesale-indexed.

assumptions.name: merchant_reference
assumptions.rationale: The historical reference is verified, but holding it constant into the future is an assumption.

assumptions.name: merchant_capture_factor
assumptions.rationale: Assumed haircut for generation profile/capture/basis; no hourly study.

assumptions.name: merchant_price_escalation
assumptions.rationale: Flat nominal reference, not a forward-market curve.

assumptions.name: post_PPA_merchant_share
assumptions.rationale: After expiry all production becomes merchant; do not extend PPA pricing.

assumptions.name: receivable_days
assumptions.rationale: Assumed settlement receivables; counterparty default needs a later separate stress.

assumptions.name: payable_days
assumptions.rationale: Applies to recurring eligible opex only, not capex, tax or financing.

assumptions.name: EPC_cost_per_kwp
assumptions.rationale: Within EMA indicative guidance; not a vendor quote. Assumed installation and interconnection included.

assumptions.name: contingency_fraction
assumptions.rationale: Planning contingency only; sufficiency not demonstrated.

assumptions.name: development_cost
assumptions.rationale: Assumed owner engineering, legal, permit and development budget.

assumptions.name: construction_draw_profile
assumptions.rationale: Six construction-quarter shares, each split evenly across three months; development paid at close.

assumptions.name: upfront_fee
assumptions.rationale: Illustrative facility fee; not DBS pricing.

assumptions.name: IDC_budget
assumptions.rationale: Funding envelope only. Actual construction interest and commitment fees must be calculated in Phase 4.

assumptions.name: initial_liquidity_budget
assumptions.rationale: Operating liquidity envelope; actual working-capital need must be tested.

assumptions.name: DSRA_budget
assumptions.rationale: Planning reserve envelope. Actual DSRA target is the next two quarters of debt service.

assumptions.name: annual_OM_per_kwp
assumptions.rationale: Unverified industrial O&M assumption, approximately 1.09% of EPC annually. Residential guidance is not directly transferable.

assumptions.name: roof_lease_per_kwp
assumptions.rationale: Assumed cash roof access payment; no actual property agreement.

assumptions.name: insurance_fraction_EPC
assumptions.rationale: Assumed annual premium as a fraction of original EPC; no insurance quote.

assumptions.name: annual_admin
assumptions.rationale: Hypothetical SPV administration and asset-management cost.

assumptions.name: annual_escalation
assumptions.rationale: Applied to recurring costs from the first full operating year.

assumptions.name: merchant_settlement_fee
assumptions.rationale: Assumed retailer/market fee only on merchant MWh, in addition to the capture haircut.

assumptions.name: replacement_cost_fraction
assumptions.rationale: Assumed inverter/replacement capex, indexed to operating year 12; deduct in CFADS.

assumptions.name: replacement_operating_year
assumptions.rationale: Replacement at end of operating year 12; replacement asset has its own book/tax schedule.

assumptions.name: decommissioning_cost
assumptions.rationale: Escalated end-of-life outflow; no salvage value.

assumptions.name: model_tax_rate
assumptions.rationale: Verified current headline rate adopted as a constant future modelling assumption; future tax law unknown.

assumptions.name: tax_allowance_years
assumptions.rationale: Assume original EPC and replacement equipment qualify for the general three-year write-off option. Eligibility not established.

assumptions.name: book_depreciation_years
assumptions.rationale: Book depreciation separate from capital allowances; replacement book life is the remaining operating life.

assumptions.name: tax_payment_lag_quarters
assumptions.rationale: Illustrative quarterly accrual and one-quarter cash lag; not the statutory payment calendar.

assumptions.name: tax_loss_carryforward
assumptions.rationale: Assume continuity and eligibility conditions met. No group relief, rebates or cash refunds for losses.

assumptions.name: GST_model_rate
assumptions.rationale: Current rate held constant; recoverable GST excluded from permanent project cost.

assumptions.name: GST_recovery_months
assumptions.rationale: Assumed full recovery within three months; tax eligibility and actual refund timing not verified.

assumptions.name: sponsor_GST_bridge_cap
assumptions.rationale: Separate capped subordinated sponsor bridge. It is not an unlimited funding plug.

assumptions.name: loan_commitment
assumptions.rationale: User-defined hypothetical request, subject to future debt-capacity testing.

assumptions.name: post_COD_tenor
assumptions.rationale: Base 60 quarterly equal-principal repayments; fixed maturity precedes PPA expiry by five years.

assumptions.name: first_repayment
assumptions.rationale: First quarter-end after base COD; delays reduce available repayment dates.

assumptions.name: fixed_maturity
assumptions.rationale: Final maturity remains fixed under construction delay; no automatic extension.

assumptions.name: benchmark_assumed
assumptions.rationale: Illustrative flat compounded-SORA-equivalent path, not an observed spot or forward quote.

assumptions.name: margin
assumptions.rationale: Illustrative 225 bp margin; not an actual DBS term or approval.

assumptions.name: benchmark_floor
assumptions.rationale: Assumed floor on the floating benchmark.

assumptions.name: hedged_fraction
assumptions.rationale: Amortising hedge begins at actual COD and ends at fixed maturity; remaining debt floats.

assumptions.name: swap_fixed_benchmark
assumptions.rationale: Hypothetical swap strike, not a quote; lending margin is added separately.

assumptions.name: commitment_fee
assumptions.rationale: Assumed fee on undrawn senior commitment during availability; included in the IDC envelope.

assumptions.name: interest_daycount
assumptions.rationale: Documented simplification using actual calendar days.

assumptions.name: equity_funding_order
assumptions.rationale: Permanent equity funds uses before senior drawings; GST bridge remains separately tracked.

assumptions.name: senior_draw_end
assumptions.rationale: Fixed six-month longstop after base COD; no further undrawn senior funding without a waiver.

assumptions.name: overrun_support_cap
assumptions.rationale: Separate capped hypothetical completion/overrun commitment, not a real Sembcorp promise.

assumptions.name: minimum_DSCR
assumptions.rationale: Illustrative covenant threshold, not DBS policy or a demonstrated feasible level.

assumptions.name: distribution_DSCR
assumptions.rationale: Historical and forward minimum quarterly DSCR tests; use available history during the first year.

assumptions.name: maximum_debt_to_cost
assumptions.rationale: Commitment divided by defined permanent funded cost; not LTV or proof of bankability.

assumptions.name: DSRA_quarters
assumptions.rationale: Target uses scheduled principal and net cash interest, excluding discretionary sweeps.

assumptions.name: equity_cure_cap
assumptions.rationale: Separate limited cash-cure capacity. Injections never increase CFADS or historical DSCR.

assumptions.name: cure_period_days
assumptions.rationale: Illustrative remedial period; subject to hypothetical legal documentation.

assumptions.name: operating_guarantee
assumptions.rationale: No full parent guarantee after completion. Only specified limited support is assumed.

assumptions.name: largest_offtaker_share
assumptions.rationale: Illustrative concentration constraint, not an identified or reviewed customer portfolio.
